label: PF Backlog 499
title: Author full implementable context (what / why / how / where) on all open backlog items
body:
## Problem / why
Several open backlog items were auto-drafted with placeholder or one-line context (approach='Implement: <title>', verification='Objective achieved: <title>'). A reader or an autonomous worker cannot implement them without extra digging.

## Goal & value
Every open item states what is required, why, how it will be done and where (files/components), with enough context that a standalone process/service can implement it.

delivery.note: Creator (_draft_context) now derives implementable context from the body; retrofitted all open items (A/B/epics from the IP plan). merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: Open items carried thin/one-line context; the creator auto-drafts placeholders, so items are not implementable standalone.
brief.what_adds: An evidence-based authoring pass over all open items AND an enhanced creator (_draft_context) that extracts real context from the item body's sections; insufficient bodies are flagged and rejected by the gate.
brief.why: The backlog is the SSOT; each item must be self-contained for humans and autonomous workers, and future items must not regress.

objective: Author implementable context (what/why/how/where) on all open backlog items AND make the backlog creator (core/backlog._draft_context) derive implementable context from the item body going forward.
acceptance_criteria: every open item states problem, what_adds, why, in/out scope, affected_components, affected_files, approach, verification
no generic 'Implement: <title>' approach or 'Objective achieved: <title>' verification remains
terse items are enriched from their epic / design doc / children (not fabricated)
core/backlog._draft_context derives problem/what_adds/in_scope/approach/verification/affected_* from the body's sections
a new item created with an insufficient body is flagged (brief.source=derived) and rejected by the open-item gate
in_scope: authoring context on all open product_forge items
core/backlog.py _draft_context derives implementable context from the body going forward
approach: Add a body-section extractor to core/backlog._draft_context (Problem/Goal/In scope/Out of scope/Approach/Acceptance) so newly created items get real context or are flagged derived; then run the same authoring over the existing open items, enriching terse ones from their epic/design/children.

prior_decisions: AGENTS.md no shortcuts; flag don't fabricate
assumptions: terse items are enriched, not invented

risks: over-editing items whose body is already authoritative

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/budget_allocator.py, core/call_ledger.py

_note: Delivered + validated (gate OK 0 residue, 13 tests passed, compileall, wired-audit unwired 0, lint clean)
